name: Middenworm

items.name: Nauseating Presence
items.text:
30 feet. DC 19 Fortitude save

As stench, but the aura affects a creature that sees, hears, or smells the middenworm.

---

items.name: Blood Drain
items.text:
Requirements A Grabbed, Paralyzed, Restrained, Unconscious, or willing creature is within reach of the middenworm's tails

---
Effect The middenworm drains blood from the victim, which must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude save save or become Drained 1. If the creature is already drained, its drained value increases by 1 (to a maximum of drained 4). The middenworm becomes Quickened until the end of its next turn, and can use the extra action to Stride, Climb, Swim, or Strike.

items.name: Midden Fever
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude save

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effects (1 day)

Stage 2 Enfeebled 1 (1 day)

Stage 3 Enfeebled 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 enfeebled 2 and Fatigued (1 day)

Stage 5 Paralyzed (1 day)

text:
Creepers of sewers and crawlers within urban dump sites, middenworms are dangerous scavengers. Eager to abandon their bottom-feeding ways, they're known to attack living foes, for fresh blood is their favorite repast. A middenworm is unpleasant to look at, listen to, or smell: a greasy maggot-like worm with hooked jaws at one end that peel back the folds of its body when it bites, and a nest of long, red, blood-drinking tendrils at the other.
Giant Middenworms
Normally, a middenworm doesn’t grow much larger than a dog, as this smaller size affords them more mobility in the sewers they frequent. Yet rarely, when middenworms have more room to grow in an area that’s particularly infused with toxic magic or fiendish influences, these creatures can grow to enormous size.
